# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.0 Worker 2 (Slot 97 oe_afr_): Africa Three Independent Civilization Axes — Solomonic Ethiopia, Mali/Songhai Timbuktu & Kilwa/Swahili/Zimbabwe (0 new rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v130_africa.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Slot 97 fallback when BYZ is gone (deduplicated per calendar month via global_var:oe_afr_ran_m)
# plus O(1) protagonist quarterly pulse on months 1/4/7/10 (staggered with Slot 98 2/5/8/11).
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_afr_fallback_pulse
		oe_afr_country_quarterly
	}
}

oe_afr_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_afr_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			current_month = 1
			current_month = 4
			current_month = 7
			current_month = 10
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_afr_init }
		}
		OR = {
			AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } tag = VEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } tag = GEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } tag = CHI }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } tag = MNG }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } NOT = { country_exists = c:MNG } tag = TUR }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_afr_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}

# Month test comes first so non-quarter months cost one comparison; only checks African protagonists.
oe_afr_country_quarterly = {
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_month = 1
			current_month = 4
			current_month = 7
			current_month = 10
		}
		oe_afr_is_protagonist = yes
		oe_afr_country_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		oe_afr_country_tick = yes
	}
}
